title: The 4 Best Mini Fridges for Garages
h1: The 4 Best Mini Fridges for Garages
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for mini fridges for garages, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini fridges for garages using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea WHS-160RB1 4.4 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.4 cu ft capacity, the largest option in this list, Simple push-button mechanical thermostat, 42 dB rated noise level.
strengths: 4.4 cu ft holds a real stock of drinks and overflow groceries
Mechanical dial thermostat is more tolerant of a dusty garage environment than a digital panel
Adjustable legs help level it on an uneven garage floor
limitations: Like all compact fridges, cooling gets inconsistent below roughly 50°F ambient
Larger footprint takes real garage floor space
features: 4.4 cu ft capacity, the largest option in this list
Small chiller compartment, not a true freezer

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK25V 2.5 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5 cu ft single-door capacity, ENERGY STAR certified, about 212 kWh/year, Small freezer compartment with ice tray.
strengths: 2.5 cu ft is enough for drinks and a small grocery overflow
Reversible door adapts to tight garage corners or workbench layouts
limitations: Small top freezer barely holds an ice tray
Same cold-ambient cooling limitations as every compact mini fridge
features: Small freezer compartment with ice tray

products.name: Galanz GLR31TBEER 3.1 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer, True dual-door design with an actual freezer, Adjustable mechanical thermostat.
strengths: Only fridge in this list that can actually freeze ice or store frozen food in the garage
Mechanical thermostat is simpler and more garage-tolerant than a digital display
3.1 cu ft split between fridge and freezer covers a workshop's mixed needs
limitations: Pricier than the single-door options in this list
Taller footprint than a basic single-door fridge
Freezer performance in a genuinely cold garage is still limited by ambient temperature
features: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer
True dual-door design with an actual freezer

products.name: Frigidaire EFR176 1.6 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6 cu ft capacity, Flush-back design for tight corner placement, Side-mounted bottle opener.
strengths: Flush back allows placement directly against a workbench or wall
Built-in bottle opener is a genuinely useful garage or workshop feature
Smallest footprint in this list for tight garage layouts
limitations: 1.6 cu ft is limited for anything beyond drinks and snacks
Plastic door handle less durable than metal handles over garage use
Runs slightly louder than the Midea per owner reports
features: Flush-back design for tight corner placement

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
